error_strings: Video subsystem has not been initialized

fault_chain: Zero native display count causes zero-sized per-display vector; allocation skipped when existing capacity>=0; data pointer remains NULL; Unity unconditionally writes element0.
scope: Confirms the immediate nil dereference and its zero-display precursor. Separate exact embedded SDL/libudev probes physically reproduce failed initialization; see ../embedded-probe/embedded-provenance.json. Does not establish Vulkan presentation or gameplay.
